User.title: User
User.description: A user of the interactive textbook. The level field represents the school level (elementary/middle/high).

level.description: The user's school level. Maps to: elementary=초등학교, middle=중학교, high=고등학교.

interests.description: Topics the user is interested in.

country.description: The user's selected country for localization.

createdAt.description: When the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: When the user profile was last updated.

Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: A broad subject area like Social Studies, Science, or History. Subjects are defined per country and school level in mockData.ts, not stored in Firestore.

id.description: Unique subject identifier, consistent across all countries and levels.

Module.title: Module
Module.description: A specific topic within a subject. 288 modules total: 8 countries × 3 school levels × 3 subjects × 4 modules. Defined in mockData.ts, not stored in Firestore.

id.description: Unique module ID using pattern: {country}-{level}-{subject}-{topic}. Example: kr-e-soc-village

subjectId.description: The parent subject this module belongs to.

achievements.description: Achievements that can be unlocked by completing this module's stories.

Achievement.title: Achievement
Achievement.description: An unlockable achievement tied to a module's story.

keyword.description: Keyword that triggers this achievement when included in a story choice.

Progress.title: Progress
Progress.description: The user's learning progress per module.

vocabCompleted.description: Whether the user has completed the vocabulary section.

userId.description: The user ID this progress belongs to.

moduleId.description: The module ID this progress belongs to.

storyProgress.description: The number of story turns completed.

storyLogs.description: Logs of story choices and their outcomes.

achievements.description: IDs of achievements unlocked for this module.

updatedAt.description: When the progress was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles. The 'level' field now stores school level keys: 'elementary', 'middle', or 'high'.

/progress/{userId_moduleId}.description: Stores user learning progress per module. ID format: {userId}_{moduleId}.

notes.curriculum_data: Subjects and Modules are NOT stored in Firestore. They are defined in mockData.ts as static data, organized by country → schoolLevel → subjects → modules.
notes.schema_migration: The 'level' field in /users/{userId} changed from locale-specific strings (초급/Beginner/初級...) to internal keys (elementary/middle/high). Existing users with old values will default to 'middle' in the theme system.
notes.total_modules: 8 countries × 3 school levels × 3 subjects × 4 modules = 288 total modules.
